title: Credential Compromise
story: Following the reconnaissance activity, the SOC detects repeated SSH authentication failures against the banking web server. A successful login from the same source occurs shortly afterward.
objective: Correlate Wazuh authentication alerts with Cowrie session telemetry to identify the compromised account, recovered credential, source address, access service and attack technique.
